variants.when: Models with a tire pressure SET (reset) switch (checked: 2014–2015 tC, 2010 xB)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb label.
Park, turn the ignition to ON, and press and hold the SET switch until the tire pressure light blinks three times.
Leave the car sitting for a few minutes so the system finishes storing the new pressures.
variants.note: Repeat after rotating or replacing tires. A light that flashes for about a minute and then stays on is a system fault that needs a dealer.

notes: Scion tire pressure systems remember whatever pressures are in the tires when the SET switch is held, so always set the pressures correctly first.
